name: v1.0.22 — App Internet Firewall, Play Store Lock & True Hardware Storage Unmasking
body:
## 🌸 Kids OS v1.0.22 Release Notes

### 🛡️ App Internet Firewall (Parent Zone)
- **Selective Internet Control**: Parents can now choose exactly which apps are allowed to access Wi-Fi and the Internet.
- **On-Device Dummy Loopback VpnService**: Blocked apps have their sockets blackholed into a 100% on-device dummy interface (`10.120.0.1`), cutting off Internet, preventing telemetry, and blocking in-game ads with ZERO lag for unblocked apps.
- **Per-App Badges**: Every app card in Parent Zone now features a quick `[🌐 Net OK]` / `[🚫 No Net]` toggle.
- **Quick Action Presets**: Added `🎮 Cut Games Internet` (instantly turns all games into 100% offline play) and `🌐 Allow All Internet`.

### 🚫 Play Store Disabled
- Permanently disabled and removed `com.android.vending` from Kids OS launcher and Parent Zone.

### 💾 True Hardware Storage & RAM Unmasking
- **Bypassed OEM Firmware Spoofing**: Fixed misleading `118 GB free` display caused by manufacturer spoofing (`persist.sys.rom = 65`, `persist.sys.ram = 4`).
- **Direct Linux Kernel Metrics**: `TrueHardwareHelper` reads `/proc/partitions` and native `statvfs("/data")` to display real physical flash storage (16 GB eMMC), user storage partition (10.2 GB), and real available space (~2.26 GB).
- **Hardware Details Dialog**: Tapping the storage banner in My Melody File Manager displays the unmasked hardware specs sheet.

### 🏎️ New Installed Game
- **Hill Climb Racing**: Installed and verified running with 32-bit native support.
